title: Orange Tender Korean Yukon Gold Potatoes Gimbap
description: A kid-friendly Korean dish featuring tender Yukon gold potatoes and a hint of citrus, wrapped in a macrobiotic-friendly gimbap form.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together orange juice, sesame oil, and soy sauce.
Add diced potatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the orange juice mixture.
Let the potatoes marinate for at least 10 minutes.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium heat and cook the marinated potatoes until tender.
Prepare a flat surface to assemble the gimbap by laying a noru sheet flat.
Spread a thin layer of cooked brown rice onto the noru sheet, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Arrange the cooked potatoes, chopped scallions, and a sprinkle of salt in the middle of the rice.
Roll the gimbap using a bamboo sushi mat or a clean tea towel.
Slice the gimbap into 8 equal pieces and serve immediately.
